player_prompt.intro:
Tqadart Mastermind.
Khassak ad tafid kud yella {code_length} isaffen, kud isaffen seg 1 ar {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Di tawsiyet-ik, tzemred ad tesekcem tawsiyet-ik s tmuqqar n: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Deg kraygat tawsiyet, ad yaweḍ kraḍ s tmuqqar n tseqqarṭin timellalin d tseqqarṭin tiberkanin.
Tseqqart tamellalt tesskan isaffen yelhan di tmeḥla yelhan, ma d tseqqart tiberkanit tesskan isaffen yelhan di tmeḥla war yelhan.
Khassak {max_turns} tawsiyin ad tesekcem kud yella.
